goal.decided: The user has each deliverable they mean made by rn, every deliverable meeting each intent of its best practice, and is asked only what is theirs.

deliverables.name: Every prose ccpm keeps is checked by lovaizu/checks
rn can plan from a best practice for planning
The shared plugin best practice says what rn and Lane share
Lane's design checks each practice step and each change
Each best practice holds the field's established way, named so its maker grasps the intent

decisions.decided: the questions ask where makers of the kind fail the role, as a run made without the best practice shows and the field's sources name, not one for each section, as a list of the failures that matter works where a list for completeness doesn't

decisions.about: A question an evaluator can be trusted on
decisions.decided: a question is used once an evaluator judges it right on several kept deliverables whose answer is known, passes and fails among them, as two verdicts on one deliverable show no reliability
a kind whose deliverable is one document gives a template, and a kind whose deliverable is a set of files of a known form, such as code or a prompt, names its parts instead
each practice is the way the field has established for its case, found by research and named with its source, not reasoned out alone

decisions.about: How a practice names an idea
decisions.decided: a practice calls an established idea by its established name, such as single responsibility or Given-When-Then, with why it serves the role, as the name carries the field's whole knowledge to a maker who knows it

the maker searches the field's primary sources and its established guides, weighs each by its authority, writes where sources disagree which way it takes and why, and stops once new sources add nothing

each practice holds its established name and other names it goes by, what the deliverable must be and why, where it applies and where it doesn't, what it costs, and its sources, as the pattern form and Google's rules with pros and cons give
a step is given only where skipping it or doing it out of order breaks the deliverable, and each such step gets its trace; the rest is left to the maker who holds the intent
the best practice gives examples that differ from one another where the kind allows, so the maker takes the intent and not one product's particulars
the evaluation comes first: real cases of the kind are made without the best practice, the shortfalls are kept, and the best practice holds what closes them, then is tried on cases held back

deliverables.name: A maker of code designs it, tests it first, and writes it as the field's established practice says

decisions.decided: the code's design, design patterns, test design, test-driven development, and the test code, each held to the same design principles as the code it tests; made anew from the goal, not by adding to what stands

the project's own linter measures each function's cyclomatic complexity against McCabe's limit of 10, and its returns, branches, arguments, and statements, on the code and its tests alike, and the existing check finds copied code, so the evaluator reads only what no machine measures, such as cohesion and coupling, which have no established limit

decisions.about: How the best practice shows it works
decisions.decided: code made by it leaves few findings to mutation testing, property-based testing, and CI: surviving mutants, with those marked as not to be mutated counted beside them, counterexamples a property finds, and CI failures after the local checks pass, each lower than the last; the evaluator's questions judge the design these tools can't see

deliverables.name: Lane's code is designed, tested first, and written as the code best practice says
Lane's code does what its design says

decisions.decided: Lane's code and tests made before go whole, and Lane is made anew by the remade code best practice, as no one can tell where code made without it falls short

on Opus by dev/lane/tests/product-vision/trial.py, its plugin given a part with no numbered list, a steps adapter, a start-text command and a route that waits for the person, and its judge counting steps out of order, starts unlike the command's text and resumes not in the person's words; its judge first right on kept records whose answer is known

deliverables.name: rn's product vision says what rn is for
A newcomer learns from the README what rn does

decisions.decided: once the rebuilt rn is built, its install steps are followed from nothing as a newcomer would, and the README is mended where they fall short
the walkthrough takes its output from a recorded run of the rebuilt rn, the product vision test's own

deliverables.name: rn's design says how a turn carries out a best practice
rn's code is designed, tested first, and written as the code best practice says
rn works as designed, with Pin and Turn removed

decisions.decided: meta's form gives each practice step a trace a machine can check, and each kind's steps get one, so rn's steps adapter hands Lane what to hold

not used: a case is one prompt in an empty workspace that never stops for an answer, while rn's walkthrough answers points and resumes; the product vision trials run on Lane's trial driver in lovaizu/playground

plugins/pin and plugins/turn go once rn holds their parts; the branch turn-held keeps the eight Turn commits no branch held, and each is taken where rn's design keeps what it fixes, then the branch goes
Lane's guard stops reading prompts/ and core/roles/ in the change that removes Pin and Turn, as their parts lie there until then

decisions.about: A start value that is null
decisions.decided: a run lane whose value is null lets no command through, and a run_step command the adapter gives counts as allowed, so the generator gets run_only

decisions.about: A file a role must not read
decisions.decided: Lane gains a lane that stops a read of the files it names, and the planner and generator get it for the design tree, as no role reads the tree
the skill names tree.py in allowed-tools, and the prose check reads no front matter, as a prompt per call costs the user time

decisions.about: Picking up a run on another branch
decisions.decided: /rn:up alone finds the runs on rn's work branches and picks up the one the user means, asking only where more than one waits
rn's code and tests made before go whole, and rn is made anew by the remade code best practice, as no one can tell where code made without it falls short
